title: LR 163 – 22nd Sunday in Ordinary Time
author: Psalm 86 (85):3,5
snippet: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I cry to you all the day long. O Lord, you are good and forgiving, full of mercy to all who call to you.

title: Responsorial Psalm - 22nd Sunday OT(A)
author: Psalm 63: 2, 3-4, 5-6, 8-9
snippet: My soul is thirsting for you, O Lord my God.

title: Gospel Acclamation - 22nd Sunday OT(A)
author: Ephesians 1:17–18
snippet: May the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ enlighten in the eyes of our hearts, that we may know what is the hope that belongs to our call.

title: The Jesus Song
author: Tom Booth
snippet: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, have mercy on me. Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, have mercy on me. Amen.

title: LR 164 - 22nd Sunday in Ordinary Time
author: Psalm 31 (30):20
snippet: How great is the goodness, Lord, that you keep for those who fear you.

title: Loving and Forgiving
author: Scott Soper
snippet: Loving and forgiving are you, O Lord; slow to anger, rich in kindness, loving and forgiving are you.

title: Taste and See
author: Steve Angrisano
snippet: Taste and see the goodness of the Lord, the goodness of the Lord. Taste and see the goodness of the Lord, the goodness of the Lord.

title: We Ever Will Praise You
author: Agnus McDonell
snippet: We ever will praise you; We ever will sing Sweet psalms of joy; To You, our King O Maker of heaven; Of earth and the sea Sweet psalms of joy ; We ever will sing

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
